headline: Azure acceleration, Street conviction
chart_note: 52-week range: $349.20 - $553.72. Currently $495.40, up about 25% over the past year, outpacing the S&P 500's 18% gain.
why_today: Q4 FY26 revenue hit $90.0B, up 18% YoY and beating estimates by $2.4B. Azure growth accelerated to 43% YoY (from ~40% in Q3), pushing full-year Azure revenue above $100B for the first time - shares rose about 8% on the report.
pro_1: Analyst consensus is Strong Buy (55 analysts), average price target $572.92 implies meaningful upside
pro_2: Azure growth is accelerating, not decelerating - a rare combination at this scale
con_1: Guidance calls for continued heavy AI infrastructure spending, which pressures near-term margins
con_2: Still down from its 52-week high of $553.72, so the market isn't fully rewarding the acceleration yet
